create_RunnerConfig: create a RunnerConfig dataclass that aggregates logger, solver, interpreter, benchmark, and launcher configs
validate_RunnerConfig: validate a RunnerConfig instance to check for empty or duplicated values in the vars dictionary
save_RunnerConfig: save a RunnerConfig instance as a JSON file to the logger output directory
get_RunnerConfig_id: get a unique hash ID for a RunnerConfig instance to aggregate runs with the same config
configure_RunnerConfig_vars: configure the vars dictionary on a RunnerConfig to sweep over override variables
